display_name: Direxion Daily Small Cap Bear 3X Shares

about.en: TZA is the Direxion Daily Small Cap Bear 3X Shares ETF, a leveraged inverse exchange-traded fund sponsored by Direxion that seeks 300% of the inverse (-3x) of the daily performance of the Russell 2000 Index before fees and expenses. Because the leverage resets daily, returns compound and can diverge substantially from -3x the index's performance over periods longer than one day. It is listed on NYSE Arca.
